title: Aknotl.fr Modpack
description: Here's a modpack tailor-made to meet the needs of the Aknotl.fr server community. It's a client-side modpack favoring optimization and light aesthetic enhancements.
body:
# AKNOTL![Aknotl Mini white](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/092be631fd4c1bfee5f3e9c57e23deeac67ee550.webp)

Welcome to the Aknotl Enhanced Performance and Utility Modpack, designed to elevate your Minecraft experience with a blend of performance enhancements and useful tools. This modpack is perfect for players looking to optimize their game while enjoying a variety of features that make building, exploring, and managing your world more enjoyable.

This is a client side only, originally designed to fit for [Aknotl](https://aknotl.fr/) server experience based on fabric.



## Key Features:

- Connected textures
- Entity model enhancement
- RAM Optimization
- Framerate improvement
- Shaders Rendering
- Schematics visualization



Don't hesitate to visit the [Server](https://aknotl.fr/) and the [Discord](https://discord.gg/VeKZreH)

 <details>
  <summary>Major Mods</summary>

  Here are the major mods installed :

  - **[[EMF]Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features)**
  - **[[ETF]Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures)**
  - **[Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity)**
  - **[Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris)**
  - **[Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica)**
  - **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)**
  - **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)**
  - **[World Edit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldedit)**
  - **[Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify)**
</details>
